evidence.title: GitHub - founded-labs/react-native-reusables: Bringing shadcn/ui to React Native. Beautifully crafted components with Nativewind/Uniwind, open source, and almost as easy to use.

name: React Native Reusables
summary: React Native port of shadcn/ui for Expo, styled with NativeWind or Uniwind and distributed as open source.
description: Brings shadcn/ui to React Native as an open-source component set for Expo apps, styled with NativeWind or Uniwind (Tailwind for React Native). A project CLI adds components into your app, and the documentation site hosts component pages and getting-started docs. The GitHub repository also publishes a community resources list of further components, libraries and templates. MIT licensed.
contains: shadcn/ui components for React Native and Expo
CLI to add components into your app
docs site with per-component pages, incl. accordion
community resources list of extra components, libraries and templates
